tools.name: search_implants
tools.description: List or search the dental implant database (manufacturer, line, connection, platforms, status). Free. Returns ids for get_implant.

tools.name: diagnose_periodontitis
tools.description: Periodontal diagnosis from a de-identified 6-point chart: 2017 AAP/EFP stage, extent, grade, ICD-10-CM suggestions, rationale and documentation checklist. Clinical decision support for licensed dental professionals. Send no patient identifiers. Costs $0.25 USDC per call (x402, Base).

tools.name: get_implant
tools.description: Full spec for one dental implant system: connection, platforms, diameters, lengths, abutment screw torque, multi-unit torque, driver, with a source URL for each value. Unknown values are null. Costs $0.05 USDC per call (x402, Base).

tools.name: identify_implant
tools.description: Rank likely dental implant systems from observed features (connection type, platform/body diameter, body shape, bone/tissue level), with reasons for each candidate. Costs $0.10 USDC per call (x402, Base).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_implant · Private data: search_implants · Public sink: diagnose_periodontitis.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_implant · Private data: search_implants · Public sink: diagnose_periodontitis

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
